and corrections. TeX Live is a joint project of the TeX user groups

at https://tug.org/usergroups.html.

Add /home/user/texlive-p5/texmf-dist/doc/info to INFOPATH.
Most importantly, add /home/user/texlive-p5/bin/x86_64-linux
to your PATH for current and future sessions.
